newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiichi Pharmaceutical sees record profit in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Daiichi Pharmaceutical sees record profit in 96/97.

text.p: Daiichi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it expected to post a record parent current profit for the year to March 31, 1997.

Daiichi's 1996/97 parent current profit will be about 44.13 billion yen against its actual 1995/96 parent current profit of 42.77 billion yen, Daiichi president Tadashi Suzuki told Reuters in an interview.
Daiichi sees its parent current profit further rising 4.2 percent year-on-year in 1997/98, Suzuki said.
Daiichi plans to pay a total dividend of 18 yen for 1997/98, up two yen from its expected dividend of 16 yen for 1996/97, he said.
